decisions.reason: As a dedicated dental thermoforming product shown on its own page, it fits closely with an established plastics-processing knowledge base that a large experienced manufacturer can readily refine and support.
A PETG thermoforming blank is highly related to core material and forming capabilities, so absorptive capacity is strong and early standalone marketing suggests meaningful commitment.

The UV-curing lacquer is adjacent to the firm's materials know-how but its weaker website presence implies a more tentative market position, raising the chance of withdrawal if learning and scale-up disappoint.
The intraoral contrast spray serves a familiar dental customer base and had a dedicated page, but it is somewhat less central to plastics manufacturing capabilities than the blank products.

A custom earmold line builds on related custom fabrication and medical-use knowledge, yet being only mentioned rather than fully presented suggests the firm is still testing how well it can absorb market feedback and standardize production.

Custom hearing protection earmolds are closely linked to earmold expertise and a solid German industrial market, so despite limited 2018 promotion the firm is likely to retain and improve them rather than exit quickly.
